cands.name: Mark Baker
cands.bio: Democrat, 69. Printer by trade; president of the Citrus County Coffee Coalition (a civic and political advocacy nonprofit) until he filed. Filed May 28 for HD 23. No office previously held in sources found.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Crystal River, Citrus County (Citrus County Chronicle, June 2026).

record.text: Filed for HD 23 on May 28; was president of the Citrus County Coffee Coalition.

cands.gaps: No campaign website or social found. A Ballotpedia headshot URL exists for "Mark Baker" but the person could not be confirmed, so no photo is included. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

cands.name: J.J. Grow
cands.bio: Republican incumbent from Inverness. Businessman with a 1992 UF agriculture degree; won the open HD 23 seat in 2024 with 74%; serves on the Health & Human Services committee. Beat Tod Cloud in the Aug. 2026 primary.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Citrus County with his wife Jen (Wikipedia); described by Florida Politics as an Inverness Republican.

record.text: Voted for SB 484 (data center costs and utility rates) and supports the November property-tax amendment, per the ClickOrlando guide.
Sits on the House Health and Human Services Committee; cites work on lower prescription drug prices.

cands.gaps: Donor detail not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
